description: ONE fantasy GLASS SHARK swimming RIGHT, clearly a shark: pointed snout, small bright eye, five gill slits, strong triangular dorsal fin, swept pectoral fins, asymmetric crescent tail at LEFT. Body looks like thick transparent icy-cyan glass drawn as crisp solid pixel facets, bright white edges, dark teal underside, 3 pale violet inner rib-like refraction bands visible through flank. A single magenta rift seam along the back. Friendly closed mouth, not a tooth monster. No aquarium, halo, ice scenery or additional fish. Cozy existing 16-bit fishing RPG sprite style. Crisp native 96x64 pixel clusters, clean selective dark outline, rich controlled 3-to-4-tone ramps per material, distinct highlights/midtones/shadows. Vivid species colors, no washed-out gray or yellow haze, no soft gradients, heavy dithering or blur. Entire single creature centered with transparent margins, head at RIGHT. Animation-ready neutral swimming pose, separate readable fin/tentacle shapes. No text, frames, scenery or external particle trails.
